name: adapt-ab-theme
description: Portable, build-free CSS token cascade — one anchor colour and a few seeds derive palette, type scale, spacing, breakpoint clamps, container-query edges and icon rosters at runtime via hsl()/calc()/clamp()/var(). Six layers (L2 adapter → L6 user pack); ships a pink pack.

layers.note: Renderer role seam; rewire this one file to port to a non-Adapt renderer.
The generic read surface; component CSS references these.
Shipped defaults (seeds + derived); each overridable by its L5 twin.
The authorable theme contract; ships empty (commented) so L4 stands.
Brand values in their own published namespace, bound into L5. Swap to recolour.

packs.name: blue
packs.note: The stock L4 default anchor, made explicit and selectable.

packs.name: cmab-dual
packs.note: Two-seed pack: dark-blue anchor + a dark-grey (#6d6d6d) pinned as the h2 tier. Own entry point: cmab-theme-pack.css.

accentSpectrum.note: 12 named families × dark/light × 9 bands (A-v2 ladder, theme-formula-map §2.8), in 8 formula sets: mono (no marker) + 7 colour-theory rotations. Plus 7 §2.5 companion single colours. Runtime-reactive off the pack anchor: chroma = accent-s (= user-s); shade-offset computed from the anchor lightness via CSS round(). A rotation rotates every family hue by its angle, so a family name denotes the slot, not the rendered hue (complementary-accent-blue is an amber).

semantics.note: Three HSL-derived cue categories (positive 145 / negative 5 / neutral 38), each with bg/border/ink/icon-colour + a ligature icon; sub-categories reuse the parent colour and set only their own icon. Formula: theme-formula-map §2.6; schema: semantics.json. Category hues are fixed (not the brand anchor). The semantic-neutral category is named 'neutral-cue' (not 'neutral') so its hue seed does not collide with the neutral spine (--ab-base-pf-default-neutral-h/-s).
